about: 2026-11-21 lumberjack / lumberjack2: a Lumberjack match (src/lumberjack.c, docs/MATCH_SLOTS.md section 4) -- the QA one-on-one (The Rock vs Austin, both the CPU) with 12 lumberjacks drawn at random from the Superstar Select (qa_lumberjacks; the default count), 2 + 12 = 14 real match slots. Before the bell the group walk-out: one after the other from the stage, two lanes, round the ring to their posts, the bell held till they are there (lj_a / lj_b); the closest two lumberjacks out never under 40 apart. Every 30 s from 15 s in the second competitor walks out of the ring (qa_lj_out); every other time he climbs back in by himself 3 s later (qa_lj_esc: the lumberjacks let him -- they stand off); the other times the swarm beats on him, then a lumberjack rolls him back in: gets hold of him (the game's grapple), lets him go to the ring (the game's walk, 126) and in under the bottom rope (the game's slide in, 155). The random draw holds no women and no announcers (lj_f); brawls between rival lumberjacks only (lj_e); the lumberjacks never in the ring, never a side; the match ends by the one-on-one's own decision; 6x
